def_en: The place where visitors arrive and give their details.
example_en: Go to the reception on the Ground Floor.
example_es: Ve a la recepción de la planta baja.

def_en: The desk where a receptionist helps visitors.
example_en: Laura greets the client at the front desk.
example_es: Laura saluda al cliente en el mostrador.

def_en: The entrance hall of a building.
example_en: Please wait in the lobby.
example_es: Por favor, espere en el vestíbulo.

def_en: The main door of a building.
example_en: Visitors enter through the main entrance.
example_es: Los visitantes entran por la entrada principal.

def_en: The floor of a building at street level.
example_en: The reception is on the ground floor.
example_es: La recepción está en la planta baja.

def_en: The floor above the ground floor.
example_en: The IT office is on the first floor.
example_es: La oficina de informática está en la primera planta.

def_en: The long passage that connects the rooms of a floor.
example_en: Walk down the main corridor.
example_es: Camine por el pasillo principal.

def_en: A machine that takes people up and down in a building.
example_en: Take the lift to the first floor.
example_es: Coja el ascensor hasta la primera planta.

def_en: Steps that connect one floor to another.
example_en: Take the stairs on your left.
example_es: Suba por las escaleras de su izquierda.

def_en: A room where employees relax and have coffee.
example_en: Turn right into the break area.
example_es: Gire a la derecha hacia la zona de descanso.

def_en: A small kitchen in an office.
example_en: Employees heat up their lunch in the kitchenette.
example_es: Los empleados calientan su comida en la cocina.

def_en: A large room for important meetings of the directors.
example_en: The meeting is in the boardroom.
example_es: La reunión es en la sala de juntas.

def_en: A room where people have meetings.
example_en: The meeting room is on your left.
example_es: La sala de reuniones está a su izquierda.

def_en: A large office without walls where many people work together.
example_en: Most staff work in the open-plan office.
example_es: La mayoría del personal trabaja en la oficina diáfana.

def_en: A room where old documents are kept.
example_en: The old contracts are in the archive room.
example_es: Los contratos antiguos están en la sala de archivo.

def_en: The office of the technicians who look after the computers.
example_en: Call the IT office if your computer crashes.
example_es: Llama a la oficina de informática si tu ordenador se bloquea.

def_en: The rooms with toilets.
example_en: The restrooms are next to the lift.
example_es: Los aseos están junto al ascensor.

def_en: A place where you leave your car.
example_en: The car park is next to the main entrance.
example_es: El aparcamiento está junto a la entrada principal.

def_en: A large building where goods are stored.
example_en: The delivery arrives at the warehouse.
example_es: El pedido llega al almacén.

def_en: A cool room where the servers are kept.
example_en: Only technicians can enter the server room.
example_es: Solo los técnicos pueden entrar en la sala de servidores.

def_en: In front of and facing something.
example_en: The boardroom is opposite the open-plan office.
example_es: La sala de juntas está enfrente de la oficina diáfana.

def_en: Very near, at the side of something.
example_en: The restrooms are next to the IT office.
example_es: Los aseos están al lado de la oficina de informática.

def_en: In the space that separates two things.
example_en: The meeting room is between the director's office and the conference room.
example_es: La sala de reuniones está entre el despacho del director y la sala de conferencias.

es: gire a la izquierda / a la derecha
def_en: To change direction to the left or to the right.
example_en: Turn left at the end of the corridor.
example_es: Gire a la izquierda al final del pasillo.

def_en: To continue in the same direction.
example_en: Walk straight ahead and you will see the door.
example_es: Siga recto y verá la puerta.
